home.planEnterprise: Mahere Hinonga: hanganga me ngā nama mutunga kore
home.upgradeMore: Whakapai ake mō ētahi atu hanganga me ngā nama
home.promptLabel: He aha te taupānga e hiahia ana koe ki te hanga?
home.promptPlaceholder: hei tauira, He rārangi mahi me te aratau pōuri, he taupānga rāhuitanga mō tōu salon, he papatohu hoko...

home.groupAI: Ngā Kaihoko AI me ngā Utauta
home.pausedCta: Kua okioki — kua pau ngā nama
home.fastDesc: Waihangatia ngā taupānga katoa i roto i ngā meneti, ehara i ngā rā.
home.aiDesc: Ka whakamahere, ka tuhi waehere, ka arotake tō taupānga te paipa kaihoko-maha.
home.prodDesc: Kaweake ki GitHub, tuku ki Vercel ki te pānga kotahi.

login.title: Nau mai anō
login.subtitle: Takiuru kia waihanga taupānga, kia whakahaere hoki tō wāhi mahi.

signup.title: Waihangatia tō pūkete
signup.subtitle: Tīmata te hanga taupānga katoa mā te AI.
signup.minChars: E 6 ngā pūāhua i te iti rawa.
signup.checkBody: I tukuna e mātou he hononga whakaū ki {email}. Whakaūngia tō wāhitau, kātahi ka takiuru hei tīmata i tō wātaka.

pricing.trialBadge: Whakamātautau 7 rā koreutu i ngā mahere utu katoa
pricing.title: Kōwhiria tō Mahere
pricing.subtitle: Hangaia ngā taupānga katoa mā te AI. Kei ia mahere tō mātou paipa kaihoko-maha. Ka pau ngā nama i ia wāhanga hanganga (Kaimahere, Kaiwaehere, Kaiarotake).
pricing.freeDesc: Mō te hunga ngahau e tūhura ana i te hanga taupānga AI
pricing.starterDesc: Taumata utu tuatahi mō ngā kaihanga takitahi
pricing.builderDesc: Mō ngā mātanga takitahi e kaha ana
pricing.studioDesc: Ngā tīma me ngā taiwhanga ngaio
pricing.enterpriseDesc: Ngā whakahaere nui me ngā hiahia ritenga
pricing.enterpriseF1: Hanganga me ngā nama mutunga kore
pricing.buyTitle: Kua pau ngā nama? Hokona ētahi atu
pricing.buySubtitle: $1 te utu o ia nama tāpiri. Ka tāpiri ki tō toenga i muri tonu i te utu, ka whakakore hoki i te okiokinga o ngā hanganga.
pricing.howTitle: Pēhea ngā Nama e Mahi ai
pricing.howIntro: Ka rere ia hanganga i tētahi paipa AI e 3 ngā wāhanga. Ka pau ngā nama i ia wāhanga:
pricing.howFooter: E 6 ngā nama o te hanganga katoa (2 + 3 + 1). Ki te pau i waenganui, ka okioki tō kaupapa, ā, ka taea e koe te tāpiri nama, te whakapai ake rānei i tō mahere. Ka pūmau ngā nama kāore i whakamahia mō ngā rā 30.

credits.title: Kua pau ngā nama — kua okioki te mahi
credits.body: E {credits} ō nama; e {cost} e hiahiatia ana kia {action}. Ka okioki ngā hanganga kia haina, kia hoko nama tāpiri rānei koe.
